title: A facet on someone else's documents
prompt: The customer wants a Clinic ID filter on files the native Drive connector already indexes. Which mechanism fits?

options.text: A custom property on the Drive datasource.
options.feedback: Custom properties belong to a datasource you index. Native and custom connectors use separate namespaces.

options.text: Re-index the Drive files through a custom connector with the property.
options.feedback: That duplicates a native connector and moves support to you.

options.text: Custom Metadata on the native Drive documents.
options.feedback: Right. Custom Metadata attaches to documents from any datasource, including native connectors, without re-indexing.

takeaway: Properties for your datasource; metadata for anyone's.
